text_blocks.snippet: The most common side effects of Opsumit (macitentan) include a stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, bronchitis, headache, flu-like symptoms, and urinary tract infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, bronchitis, headache, flu-like symptoms, and urinary tract infections

list.snippet: Serious birth defects: Opsumit can harm an unborn baby and must not be taken during pregnancy.
Liver problems: It can cause liver damage. Watch for nausea, vomiting, upper right stomach pain, extreme tiredness, loss of appetite, dark urine, or yellowing of the skin/eyes (jaundice).
Fluid retention: Swelling in the hands, legs, ankles, or feet, or rapid weight gain can happen, usually within the first few weeks.
Low red blood cells (Anemia): This can cause unusual tiredness, weakness, or pale skin.
Decreased sperm counts: Opsumit may affect male fertility.
